name: cursor-bridge
description: Use Cursor as a verifiable context engine or bounded worker, including a UI-suppressed minimal runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Verifiable Cursor Context Engine search and bounded work.
interface.longDescription: Use Cursor's indexed Agent as a Cursor Context Engine that returns path:line evidence instead of guessed locations, or hand it a clearly bounded task while Codex keeps final control. Minimal runtime keeps cursor_search and cursor_do available while hiding the Windows Cursor UI. Tasks can use FIFO or separate top-level Cursor Agents with stable IDs and non-overlapping write paths.
defaultPrompt: Use cursor_search as a Cursor Context Engine for intent-based lookup with verifiable path:line evidence; prefer local exact search for obvious literals.
Use cursor_runtime when the user wants normal or UI-suppressed minimal Cursor operation.
Use cursor_policy to follow the user's preferred level of Cursor involvement. Active is the recommended default for regular teamwork.

When a useful bounded handoff exists, give Cursor a clear goal, scope, boundaries, and acceptance checks. Collect the task with cursor_status, inspect the real changes, and keep final approval in Codex.

Run independent tasks as separate top-level Cursor Agents only when their write paths do not overlap. Keep the work in Codex when it requires product judgment, shared-path ownership, or final verification.
